newsitem.title: SPAIN: Policeman killed as car explodes in northern Spain.
newsitem.headline: Policeman killed as car explodes in northern Spain.

text.p: A national policeman was killed as his car exploded in the northern Spanish town of Bilbao on Monday morning, regional police said.
"A policemen has been killed as a result of the explosion," a spokesman said.
A bomb had been placed in the policeman's car, which was parked at the back of a school. It exploded as he turned on the engine at about 0900 local time.
No children were hurt in the explosion, police said.
They added it was too early to say whether the separatist group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) was behind the attack.
"We cannot make that valuation yet," the spokesman said.
ETA, which has killed some 800 people in its 29-year drive for independence, stepped up its attacks last week, killing three people including a Supreme Court judge.
